title: RNAflow
text: Downstream bulk RNA-seq analysis platform — interactive Shiny app, packaged R package. RNAflow modular Shiny application built proper R package downstream bulk RNA-seq analysis. takes raw count matrices sample metadata input provides differential expression (DESeq2), QC diagnostics, sample overviews (PCA / UMAP / 3D PCA), linked volcano-table explorer, multi-contrast comparisons, functional enrichment (GSEA / ORA, interactive enrichment network), co-expression network analysis (WGCNA), transcription-factor pathway activity inference (decoupleR), per-sample gene-set signatures (GSVA / ssGSEA), optional AI-assisted interpretation, publication-ready figures, reproducible R-script / HTML report / Methods-paragraph export. Supported organisms: human, mouse, rat.
